summary: An open, community-run network of websites I own end to end. Launched in 2026 as a single live-streaming site and grown, in the same year, into more than fifty connected sites that share one login, with me as the only engineer on it.
bullets: Designed and built a network of 50+ websites that share one account: live streaming, chat and video, a wallet and payments, an AI model marketplace, travel, shopping and job search, a browser game and more. Over a million lines of code and 900+ web endpoints, all built, deployed and run by me alone.

Built the live-streaming engine from the ground up: anyone can broadcast from a browser or an app, and it re-broadcasts to Twitch, YouTube, Kick and more at once, saves the recording and cuts short clips. It captions and translates streams into about 21 languages live, and AI picks the best moments and writes up what every stream talked about.

Ran it like a real product: zero-downtime deploys, a homepage that loads about twice as fast without layout jumps, and a move of every site to new infrastructure and PostgreSQL with every user, balance and active player carried over, with zero downtime and zero data loss.

Built its AI side: one account that reaches every major AI model with live prices, speed and uptime; agents that write code and finish tasks while people watch them work live; and an app that connects your own computer to run AI or share it.
